labs.join_notes: Says the center supports fellows who come to Fletcher for research and teaching on technology and economic integration, and tells interested people to use a contact link; lists only past fellows (two faculty fellows). No application steps or named contact shown.
labs.notes: Leadership page names three people: Wolff, Liliya Khasanova (post-doctoral research fellow and associate director) and Thomas Cao (Assistant Professor of Technology Policy). Faculty affiliates and affiliated students are on separate pages that were not read, so no core count. The Fellowships page also lists two current-looking doctoral fellows (Melita Sawyer, Jamilah Welch). No email shown.
